question_patterns: 為什麼跑很快，就會喘喘的
first_sentence: 這是喘氣！因為跑步時，身體需要更多氧氣。
facts: 我們吸進的氧氣，會送到肌肉去用
跑得快，心跳和呼吸都會變快
停下來休息，呼吸就會慢慢變慢
ask_back: 喘的時候，呼吸會變快還是變慢？

bridges.rides_bike: 騎腳踏車騎很久，也會喘喘的嗎？
bridges.has_dog: 狗狗跑完，也會吐出舌頭喘氣嗎？

author: claude-haiku

question_patterns: why am I breathing so fast
why do I breathe hard when I run
why is my breath so fast
en.first_sentence: This is panting! Running needs more air, so you breathe faster.
facts: The air you breathe in goes to your muscles to use.
When you run fast, your heart and breath both speed up.
Rest for a while, and your breathing slowly slows down.
en.ask_back: Do you think you breathe faster after a long run, or after a nap?

bridges.rides_bike: After riding your bike a long way, do you get puffed out?
bridges.has_dog: Does your dog pant with its tongue out after running?
